messages:
jess: Quick async check — pricing/packaging rollout: are we still blocked on metering schema changes for SKU-level tiers? Need a short owners + ETA so PM can update launch plan.

omar: Not fully blocked but there's one breaking change: quota_key is moving from "plan_id" to "sku_id" in the metering payload.

leena: Correct. We started the migration but the adapter change in billing is the gating item. Metering side can emit both keys for 2 weeks to allow a smooth cutover.

ben: Billing team needs ~5 business days to accept sku_id and map it to existing ratecards — depends on availability of the new lookup table from contracts.

jess: Who owns the lookup table? Contracts or sales ops?

ben: Contracts owns canonical mapping, but Sales Ops has the in-flight overrides. We need both. I'm pulling a small script to reconcile.

leena: Suggestion: metering emits dual-key mode behind feature flag METRICS_SKU_MIGRATE=true so we can flip once billing confirms mapping is complete.

omar: Agreed. Also, one runtime note: continuous batching needs to be aware of the sku_id for per-SKU concurrency limits. That change is tiny (1 extra header) but needs a canary release.

jess: OK. Action items: 1) Contracts to provide lookup table (owner: contracts; ETA Wed EOD) 2) Billing to update adapter to accept sku_id and run reconcile (owner: ben; ETA next Fri) 3) Metering to emit dual-key behind flag (owner: leena; ETA Tue) 4) Runtime canary for batching change (owner: omar; ETA Thu).

ben: Ack. I'll start the adapter PR today and tag @billing-bot for CI.

billing-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch feature/billing/sku-mapping — 4/6 checks passed, failing on e2e ratecard tests.

ben: Re e2e fails — looks like test data needs sku -> plan fallback. Pushing fix now.

jess: If we hit any contract constraints (e.g., legacy enterprise quotes tied to plan_id), call it out immediately. We can gate those with a manual exclusion list in the mapping.

leena: Noted. We'll add a validation step that flags unmapped plan_ids during ingest and route them to the legacy path until resolved.

omar: For rollout, propose: canary group (5% requests) -> monitor cost/latency/regressions -> 50% -> full. Any objections?

ben: Sounds good. I'll add a dashboard card for billing deltas and invoice preview for the canary runs.

jess: Great. I'll update the launch calendar and ping sales ops to prioritize mapping. Thanks all :raised_hands:

leena: One last thing — does legal need to sign off on changing emitted identifiers?

jess: Good call. I'll loop legal if contracts flag any T&Cs. For now, keep the dual-key plan.

ben: Tagging the tasks in the pricing epic and adding owners. Will post PR link when ready.

omar: Ping me on the canary rollout day and I'll coordinate the runtime deploy window.

jess: Perfect — closing the loop here. If anything slips, post updates in this thread.
